title: Tanzanian Prawn and Mango Salad
author: Chef Fatuma
desc: Tanzanian Kamba na Embe — chilled cooked prawns over sliced fresh mango with a lime-chilli-coriander dressing. A refreshing Zanzibar starter combining the island's finest prawn with extraordinary mango. Light, vibrant, completely tropical.
longDesc: Prawn and mango is Zanzibar's most refreshing starter — the sweetness of fresh Zanzibari mango, the briny freshness of Indian Ocean prawns, and the lime-chilli dressing create a combination perfectly matched to the warm coastal climate.
ingredients: 2 large ripe mangoes — peeled and sliced
¼ red onion — very thinly sliced
steps: Top with chilled prawns and red onion.
Scatter coriander and chilli slices. Serve immediately.
cookingScience: Lime juice slightly firms mango surface proteins, preserving texture. Capsaicin from chilli activates heat receptors that enhance sweet flavour perception — making the mango taste sweeter.
sustainabilityTips: Zanzibar mangoes and Indian Ocean prawns — completely locally sourced.
healthBenefits: Vitamin C and beta-carotene from mango.
culturalNote: Prawn and mango starter is Zanzibar's modern food culture at its most confident — taking what the island grows and catches, combining with intelligence, creating something that belongs entirely to this place.
